Appreciate any help — our lead engineer (cc'd) and I want to avoid re-running long experiments if the environment drops.

If you can reply with those two items, I'll push this today.

Olga / Ben — saw Carlos's note. Approved: we can issue a one-time micro-extension voucher equal to 50k tokens and keep the sandbox live for up to 5 additional days, preserving the instance state. Please include a short expiration policy and mark this as non-recurring.

Notes for the voucher:
- Token amount: 50,000 generation tokens (can be used for any hosted model in their trial instance)
- Duration: 5 calendar days extension from the current scheduled shutdown
- Conditions: single-use voucher tied to CatalystRx account; procurement PO must be submitted within the extension window or access reverts to read-only.

Ben — please confirm accounting that this fits within our standard trial credit approvals and flag anything we should track against DEAL-2027-1193.

Carlos — good news. Per Marcus's approval, we're issuing a one-time micro-extension to keep your sandbox live and preserve the instance state. Summary below and voucher attached:

What we're granting
- 72-hour extension window (sandbox stays active through 2027-05-12 09:42 PDT) — this preserves running experiments and KV caches in-place.
- 50,000 token voucher (redwood_trial_voucher_50000tokens.pdf) that can be consumed within the extension window.
- Non-recurring; voucher expires at the end of the extension window.

Conditions and next steps
- Procurement should upload the signed PO to procurement@redwood.com or reply-all with the attached PDF before 2027-05-12 to transition to billed access.
- If security needs any further artifacts (SOC2 evidence, data retention policy) please let me know and I'll push them directly.

Attached: redwood_trial_voucher_50000tokens.pdf, SOW_draft_v1.docx (SOW for pilot scope).

If you want me to extend to the full five days (per Marcus' note) instead of 72 hours, I can do that immediately on request — I wanted to confirm you're able to act inside 72 hours first.

Thanks, and happy to hop on a 15-min call if helpful.

—Olga
